town_description: Dhamtari is a city and district headquarters in Chhattisgarh on the Mahanadi, about 78 km from Raipur. It is the gateway to the Gangrel (Ravishankar) reservoir and Sitanadi Wildlife Sanctuary, and is a major regional centre of Shakti worship.
